title: Reward versus emotion prediction-error physiology

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Historical developer controls remain scoped engineering evidence; this revision runs no model and does not turn source inspection into a performance result.
excluded_claims: No source-paper coefficient agreement as a reward for neuroscientific truth.
No calibrated uncertainty or PE-specific causal permutation test.

disposition_reason: A concrete processed-ERP prediction/investigation source exists for 33 exposed people with an optional frozen-33/test-eight protocol. Its actual loss target differs from the original coefficient-reconstruction emphasis; current definition adopts the observed ERP prediction endpoint and keeps author coefficient reproduction separate.

scientific_target.question: How much do reward and valence prediction-error variables improve held-person FRN and P3b amplitude prediction over shared outcome/history covariates under a fixed predictive procedure?
scientific_target.known_answer: Held-person author-processed FRN_N2_offer and P3b_offer amplitudes in the original exported units, paired on source rows where both targets and predictors are present. Free prose and favored coefficient signs are not known answers.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Pinned author df_FRN_N2_offer.csv and df_P3b_offer.csv, positionally aligned to BEH_ug.csv. Independent raw-epoch identity remains unresolved.
scientific_target.case_unit: A held participant with all behavior-complete query rows; predict both ERP amplitudes for every query before the private paired-target mask is applied.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant; 180 original ordered trials are nested within each of 41 source people. LOPO folds share training sets.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional predictive association in processed summaries, not raw neural waveform interpretation or a causal decomposition of reward/emotion mechanisms. The predictive random-intercept ML models are not source-paper random-slope REML reproduction.
exclusions: No source-paper coefficient agreement as a reward for neuroscientific truth.
No calibrated uncertainty or PE-specific causal permutation test.

inputs: Training-person processed ERP labels plus original outcome/expectation primitives offer, rp, exp_valence, ep_valence, exp_arousal, ep_arousal; trialLocal/trialGlobal and derived absolute R/V/A prediction errors.
Held-person behavior-complete rows carrying source_row identities, without FRN/P3b targets; target-specific missingness remains private.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person FRN/P3b outcomes, missing-target eligibility masks or private numerical scores.
Query fitting or calibration; cross-case mutable state; reserved target access during development.
Administrative source_row/participant identities as predictive features; they identify/group observations only.
observation_contract.case_identity: Original one-based source_row and participant identity; project() verifies three 7,380-row source files and all 41 people with 180 ordered trials. No public authentic case payload is included.
observation_contract.split: Implemented design: development_lopo33 uses the old 26 training plus seven exposed development people, 32 training people per observed fold. Separate reserved_frozen33_test8 fits once on 33 then predicts all eight held people; no reserve execution or release is implied.
observation_contract.coverage: All 33 development person episodes and both modes are required before aggregate scores; paired scored row counts depend on authenticated source missingness and are not fabricated here. Reserve scope is all eight people under a separate frozen protocol.

primary.name: equal_person_training_variance_normalized_MSE_for_each_ERP
primary.aggregation: For FRN and P3b separately: per-person MSE divided by outer-training equal-person variance, then equal-person mean. Preserve both component endpoints; do not collapse unlike amplitudes without a declared rule.
primary.rationale: Grades prediction of measured neural summaries rather than reconstruction of source coefficients; training-only normalization permits explicit component comparisons without using held-target variance.

secondary: Raw MSE and MAE in original amplitude units, complete per-person paired target support.
R versus V, reward increment V−J, valence increment R−J and joint versus nuisance N−J normalized-loss contrasts.
P3b-minus-FRN difference of normalized predictive contrasts, with both constituent values.
Evidence-linked numeric-claim consistency and explicit limitations, separate from neural prediction performance.

comparators.name: N / R / V / J
comparators.inputs: Common nuisance model; nuisance plus reward, valence, or joint prediction-error variables.
comparators.procedure: Existing training-standardized ML models with common random intercept; all five arms and both ERP targets must complete. The original eight fits and independent design audit are retained.

nuisance_controls: Joint reward/valence/arousal and outcome/expectation covariates; compare incremental held-person loss rather than unadjusted coefficient signs.
Keep paired FRN/P3b trajectories and missingness together; verify exact row identities, not only row counts.
If a trajectory-alignment diagnostic is selected, preserve explicit 26/7 exchangeability blocks; this is not a PE-specific conditional null.
Full covariance is needed for within-component coefficient differences; never subtract unnormalized FRN/P3b coefficients.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain per-person losses and contrasts, their descriptive distribution and declared participant resampling sensitivity only. Every training transform/selection/model refits per replicate; overlapping LOPO training and previous development tuning prevent automatic calibrated intervals. No p-value supplied.
evaluation.failure_policy: Predict every behavior-complete query exactly once with finite FRN/P3b values. Missing/abstained output or incomplete reference/model/replicate prevents a complete aggregate; retain failures and do not drop unsuccessful people.

implementation.scorer_target: analysis.score_case scores held processed amplitudes with MSE/MAE/training-normalized MSE; aggregate retains mode/reference contrasts. Numeric evidence claims are checked against tool replies, not awarded free-prose truth credit. Separate row-eligibility checker validates supplied row records only.
implementation.delivered_scope: Candidate packet projection, source-defined paired frozen/adaptive protocol, actual target-loss functions, immutable fit-state interface and failure-preserving source are present. Root selection, original-data admission and qualified runtime remain separate.
missing: Authenticate independent ERP event alignment and original preprocessing/units beyond positional exports.
Qualify and bind actual source closure, bootstrap interpreter, image and finite execution plan.
Select adequately justified reference competence and resampling interpretation before any scientific study.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source/engineering components are present; no fresh authentic evaluation or model trial was run in this revision. Row-eligibility tests use invented records and do not open original exports.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed no-tools numeric behavior-to-ERP prediction with explicitly bounded training examples.
direct_observation.boundary: Query ERP amplitudes remain hidden; an ERP waveform cannot be shown without revealing this target.
missing: No direct-response collector or fixed finite training-presentation condition.

typed_viewer.representation: This endpoint predicts neural amplitude targets from behavioral covariates; exposing the query ERP waveform through a neural viewer would reveal the answer.
typed_viewer.boundary: A future viewer may visualize permitted behavioral covariates, but that is a different observation representation, not direct interpretation of hidden ERP targets.
missing: No valid neural-input viewer condition for the present encoding direction.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-person adaptive investigation with training_summary, reference_prediction and predictive_coefficients; numerical Python/R analysis allowed.
tool_assisted.boundary: Matched input projection, tool catalogue/call caps and process limits; no held-target feedback; fresh per-person state.
missing: Qualified actual-root execution and candidate semantic feature-use review.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted prediction/investigation program; reserved protocol trains one immutable artifact on33 before any of eight query people.
frozen_program.boundary: Same tool opportunities as adaptive comparator; no target-batch fitting, reserve adaptation or cross-person mutable state.
missing: Actual source/runtime qualification and complete finite execution.

evidence.supports: Exact source roster/splits, primitives, modes, finite plans and diagnostic restrictions.
Behavior-complete query production and separate paired-target masks.
Genuine held-target losses, component/arm contrasts and complete cohort aggregation.
Predictive versus paper-model scope, source-only reserve protocol and evidence-linked investigation boundary.
Row consistency checker does not authenticate original exports or execute R.
Original positional concatenation and random-slope models differ from delivered predictive random-intercept source. Reopened 2026-11-16.
Concrete bounded training-summary/reference-prediction/coefficient tool calls and evidence-linked numeric final claims.
Actual matched candidate episode orchestration and full output commitment before private scoring; reserved stage freezes models before eight held people.

summary: Adopts the existing actual held-person ERP-amplitude prediction target as primary; source-paper coefficient reconstruction remains a distinct paper task.
Distinguishes exposed33 LOPO from frozen33/test8 reserve, and behavior-complete predictions from paired-target scoring.
Prevents a neural viewer from revealing this encoding task’s hidden targets and keeps numeric-report consistency separate from scientific reasoning.
revision.source_review: Read actual packet projection, score_case/aggregate, protocol and runtime scientific contract; reopened pinned author analysis to verify the model/endpoint distinction. No authentic labels read.
